title.en: How the map is built and read, and what this frozen release contains.
title.zh: 地图怎样构建、怎样判读，以及这一冻结版本包含什么。

lead.en: Field statistics use first-publication dates through 30 September 2026; the map was frozen on 24 October 2026. This release does not update.
lead.zh: 领域统计使用截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的首次公开日期；地图于 2026 年 10 月 24 日冻结。本版本不再更新。

title.en: Consensus clusters from text and shared references.
title.zh: 基于文本与共同参考文献的共识星团。

steps.en: Similarity
steps.zh: 相似度

steps.en: SPECTER2 title–abstract similarity with bibliographic coupling (α = 4/7); 15 neighbours
steps.zh: SPECTER2 标题摘要相似度结合文献耦合（α = 4/7）；15 近邻

steps.en: Consensus
steps.zh: 共识

steps.en: 20 seeded Leiden partitions, co-assignment matrix, constant-Potts partition (γ = 0.5)
steps.zh: 20 次带种子的 Leiden 划分、共现矩阵、常数 Potts 划分（γ = 0.5）

steps.en: Themes
steps.zh: 主题

steps.en: A coarser consensus groups the 61 clusters into 14 themes
steps.zh: 更粗的共识把 61 个星团归为 14 个主题

steps.en: Population
steps.zh: 人群

steps.en: Works with reference lists are clustered; 50 more join a theme by text voting; 330 stay unassigned in every denominator
steps.zh: 有参考文献的论文进入聚类；另有 50 篇按文本投票归入主题；330 篇未归类，仍在各分母中

title.en: Structural changes count only when they survive perturbation.
title.zh: 结构变化只有在扰动下仍然存在才计入。

steps.en: Time slices
steps.zh: 时间切片

steps.en: 12 quarterly maps, each from works public at that cutoff
steps.zh: 12 个季度地图，每个只用当时已公开的论文

steps.en: Member flows
steps.zh: 成员流动

steps.en: Hypergeometric overlap with Benjamini–Hochberg q ≤ 0.05, at least three shared works, flow fraction ≥ 0.3
steps.zh: 超几何重叠检验（BH q ≤ 0.05）、至少 3 篇共同论文、流动比例 ≥ 0.3

steps.en: Perturbation
steps.zh: 扰动

steps.en: 200 deletion runs, 20 seeds, 6 parameter variants; rule frozen before confirmation
steps.zh: 200 次删减、20 个种子、6 个参数变体；规则在确认前冻结

steps.en: Cases
steps.zh: 案例

steps.en: Each retained change read in its source passages
steps.zh: 每个保留的变化回到原文阅读

title.en: Records link a later experiment to what it used and to the inputs a defence trusts.
title.zh: 记录把后续实验连到它所用的成果，以及防御所信任的输入。

steps.en: Used contribution
steps.zh: 被使用的成果

steps.en: Purpose (baseline, resource, method), unit (whole, variant, component), external authors only, version-dated passage
steps.zh: 用途（基线、资源、方法）、单位（整体、变体、组件），只计外部作者，按版本定日期的原文

steps.en: Trusted inputs
steps.zh: 可信输入

steps.en: Which inputs a defence relies on, who produces them, and whether an experiment changes or corrupts them
steps.zh: 防御依赖哪些输入、由谁产生、实验是否改变或破坏它们

steps.en: Coverage
steps.zh: 覆盖

steps.en: Closest existing works and their conditions, from corpus and outside searches
steps.zh: 最接近的已有工作及其条件，来自语料内外的检索
